  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d

```{r}
library(rvest)
library(httr)
```

# Import NSDUH

```{r}
url = "https://www.samhsa.gov/data/sites/default/files/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015/NSDUHsaeShortTermCHG2015.htm"

drug_use_html =
  read_html(url)
```

Pull the tables out

```{r}
drug_use_html |> 
  html_table()
```

If all we really care about is the first table...
  
slice(-1) subtracts out the first row

```{r}
marj_df = 
  drug_use_html |> 
  html_table() |> 
  first() |> 
  slice(-1)
```

# Import some starwars data:

pull in the html.

```{r}
swm_html = 
  read_html_live("https://www.imdb.com/list/ls070150896/")
```

next up... selector gadget

```{r}
title_vec =
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".ipc-title-link-wrapper .ipc-title__text") |> 
  html_text()

metascore_vec = 
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".metacritic-score-box") |>
  html_text()

runtime_vec = 
  swm_html |>
  html_elements(".base .ipc-inline-list__item:nth-child(2)") |>
  html_text()

swm_df = 
  tibble(
    title = title_vec,
    score = metascore_vec,
    runtime = runtime_vec
  )

```

## USE APIs

```{r}
nyc_water = 
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.csv") |> 
  content("parsed") |> 
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day)
```

get a json file

```{r}
nyc_water_json = 
  GET("https://data.cityofnewyork.us/api/v3/views/ia2d-e54m/query.json")
  
nyc_water_json |> 
  content("text") |>
  jsonlite::fromJSON() |>
  as_tibble() |> 
  select(year:per_capita_gallons_per_person_per_day)

```

Look at some pokemon!

```{r}
pokemon_json =
  GET("http://pokeapi.co/api/v2/pokemon/1")

pokemon_data =
  pokemon_json |> 
  content()

pokemon_data[["name"]]
pokemon_data[["height"]]
pokemon_data[["abilities"]]
```
